butterflymuffin.test: (names.butterflywings or names.moonbutterflywings) and not tags.meat and tags.veggie and tags.veggie >= 0.5

frogglebunwich.test: (names.froglegs or names.froglegs_cooked) and tags.veggie and tags.veggie >= 0.5

pumpkincookie.test: (names.pumpkin or names.pumpkin_cooked) and tags.sweetener and tags.sweetener >= 2

stuffedeggplant.test: (names.eggplant or names.eggplant_cooked) and tags.veggie and tags.veggie > 1

fishsticks.test: tags.fish and names.twigs and (tags.inedible and tags.inedible <= 1)

honeynuggets.test: names.honey and tags.meat and tags.meat <= 1.5 and not tags.inedible

honeyham.test: names.honey and tags.meat and tags.meat > 1.5 and not tags.inedible

kabobs.test: tags.meat and names.twigs and (not tags.monster or tags.monster <= 1) and (tags.inedible and tags.inedible <= 1)

ratatouille.test: not tags.meat and tags.veggie and tags.veggie >= 0.5 and not tags.inedible

jammypreserves.test: tags.fruit and not tags.meat and not tags.veggie and not tags.inedible

fruitmedley.test: tags.fruit and tags.fruit >= 3 and not tags.meat and not tags.veggie

fishtacos.test: tags.fish and (names.corn or names.corn_cooked or names.oceanfish_small_5_inv or names.oceanfish_medium_5_inv)

waffles.test: names.butter and (names.berries or names.berries_cooked or names.berries_juicy or names.berries_juicy_cooked) and tags.egg

monsterlasagna.test: tags.monster and tags.monster >= 2 and not tags.inedible

powcake.test: names.twigs and names.honey and (names.corn or names.corn_cooked or names.oceanfish_small_5_inv or names.oceanfish_medium_5_inv)

unagi.test: (names.cutlichen or names.kelp or names.kelp_cooked or names.kelp_dried) and (names.eel or names.eel_cooked or names.pondeel)

flowersalad.test: names.cactus_flower and tags.veggie and tags.veggie >= 2 and not tags.meat and not tags.inedible and not tags.egg and not tags.sweetener and not tags.fruit

icecream.test: tags.frozen and tags.dairy and tags.sweetener and not tags.meat and not tags.veggie and not tags.inedible and not tags.egg

watermelonicle.test: names.watermelon and tags.frozen and names.twigs and not tags.meat and not tags.veggie and not tags.egg

trailmix.test: (names.acorn or names.acorn_cooked) and tags.seed and tags.seed >= 1 and (names.berries or names.berries_cooked or names.berries_juicy or names.berries_juicy_cooked) and tags.fruit and tags.fruit >= 1 and not tags.meat and not tags.veggie and not tags.egg and not tags.dairy

hotchili.test: tags.meat and tags.veggie and tags.meat >= 1.5 and tags.veggie >= 1.5

guacamole.test: names.mole and (names.rock_avocado_fruit_ripe or names.cactus_meat) and not tags.fruit

jellybean.test: names.royal_jelly and not tags.inedible and not tags.monster

vegstinger.test: (names.asparagus or names.asparagus_cooked or names.tomato or names.tomato_cooked) and tags.veggie and tags.veggie > 2 and tags.frozen and not tags.meat and not tags.inedible and not tags.egg

bananapop.test: (names.cave_banana or names.cave_banana_cooked) and tags.frozen and names.twigs and not tags.meat and not tags.fish

ceviche.test: tags.fish and tags.fish >= 2 and tags.frozen and not tags.inedible and not tags.egg

salsa.test: (names.tomato or names.tomato_cooked) and (names.onion or names.onion_cooked) and not tags.meat and not tags.inedible and not tags.egg

pepperpopper.test: (names.pepper or names.pepper_cooked) and tags.meat and tags.meat <= 1.5 and not tags.inedible

californiaroll.test: ((names.kelp or 0) + (names.kelp_cooked or 0) + (names.kelp_dried or 0)) == 2 and (tags.fish and tags.fish >= 1)

surfnturf.test: tags.meat and tags.meat >= 2.5 and tags.fish and tags.fish >= 1.5 and not tags.frozen

sweettea.test: (names.forgetmelots or names.forgetmelots_dried) and tags.sweetener and tags.frozen and not tags.monster and not tags.veggie and not tags.meat and not tags.fish and not tags.egg and not tags.fat and not tags.dairy and not tags.inedible

koalefig_trunk.test: (names.trunk_summer or names.trunk_cooked or names.trunk_winter) and (names.fig or names.fig_cooked)

figatoni.test: (names.fig or names.fig_cooked) and tags.veggie and tags.veggie >= 2 and not tags.meat

figkabab.test: (names.fig or names.fig_cooked) and names.twigs and tags.meat and tags.meat >= 1 and (not tags.monster or tags.monster <= 1)

veggieomlet.test: tags.egg and tags.egg >= 1 and tags.veggie and tags.veggie >= 1 and not tags.meat and not tags.dairy

beefalofeed.test: tags.inedible and not tags.monster and not tags.meat and not tags.fish and not tags.egg and not tags.fat and not tags.dairy and not tags.magic

beefalotreat.test: tags.inedible and tags.seed and (names.forgetmelots or names.forgetmelots_dried) and not tags.monster and not tags.meat and not tags.fish and not tags.egg and not tags.fat and not tags.dairy and not tags.magic
